title: Artifact policy verdict
description: Structured output of the policy review defined in prompt.md (ADR-0007). Keeping the verdict structured is what makes review auditable and, later, automatable without rewriting the policy.

passes.description: true only if the artifact is safe, has no broad-scope hooks, has no undisclosed telemetry, its description matches its behavior, and its data classification is accurate.

summary.description: Brief description of what the artifact actually does, written from the payload rather than from its description.

violations.description: Specific files or hooks and the issue found, or an empty string. When passes is false this MUST cite the file and state what the user was not told.

hooks.description: One string per registered hook: 'EVENT:path — gated|ungated — network:yes(host)|no'. Empty array when the artifact registers no hooks.

has_broad_scope_hooks.description: true if any UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook runs without a relevance gate, or any hook reads data beyond the stated scope.

has_undisclosed_telemetry.description: true if any hook or shipped code calls a non-MCP host without explicit disclosure and a documented opt-out.

description_matches_behavior.description: false if a person reading only the description would be surprised by the hooks, telemetry, or data access found.

data_classification_accurate.description: false if the artifact can cause data above its declared classification to leave the machine.

is_atomic.description: false if the artifact serves more than one purpose. Advisory: does not fail the review on its own.

reviewer.description: GitHub handle of the human reviewer, or the model identifier when automated.
